description: This file defines a class 'CustomStorageAdaptor' that implements a log consistency adaptor using a custom storage interface within the Orleans framework. It manages reading, writing, and notification processing for log views and entries, including handling primary storage interactions and versioning.

classes.name: CustomStorageAdaptor`2
classes.description: A log consistency adaptor that uses a user-provided storage interface to manage log views and entries, supporting read/write operations, notifications, and version control within Orleans.

classes.name: CustomStorageAdaptor`2.ReadRequest
classes.description: A message class representing a read request with a known version, used in protocol communication.

classes.name: CustomStorageAdaptor`2.ReadResponse`1
classes.description: A message class representing a read response containing the version and value of the log view.

classes.name: CustomStorageAdaptor`2.UpdatePrimaryFailed
classes.description: A class indicating failure when updating the primary storage.

classes.name: CustomStorageAdaptor`2.ReadFromPrimaryFailed
classes.description: A class indicating failure when reading from the primary storage.

classes.name: CustomStorageAdaptor`2.UpdateNotificationMessage
classes.description: A notification message sent after updates, containing the version and list of log entries.

methods.name: LastConfirmedView
methods.description: Returns the last confirmed log view cached in the adaptor.

methods.name: GetConfirmedVersion
methods.description: Returns the current confirmed version number.

methods.name: InitializeConfirmedView
methods.description: Initializes the cached view and version number.

methods.name: MakeSubmissionEntry
methods.description: Creates a new submission entry from a log entry.

methods.name: OnMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming protocol messages, specifically read requests, and responds with the current view if applicable.

methods.name: ReadAsync
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous read from the storage, updating cache and version, with retry logic.

methods.name: WriteAsync
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous write of batched updates to storage, updating cache and version, with retry and recovery logic.

methods.name: ProcessNotifications
methods.description: Processes queued notifications to update the local view based on received updates.

methods.name: enter_operation
methods.description: Logs entry into an operation for debugging.

methods.name: exit_operation
methods.description: Logs exit from an operation for debugging.
